contents.name: Identifier
contents.description: The direct identifier for the OPC UA node (eg. "ns=1;i=0") or the browse path (eg. "3:Data/3:Dynamic/3:Scalar/3:BooleanValue") of the OPC UA node to be read.

contents.name: Value
contents.description: Value which will be written to the OPC UA Node (eg."1.2232" for a Double or "Hello" for a String)
